ultrasonic: 40 kHz sound pings and echoes measure distance (parking sensors, tank level, robot distance)
ir: an IR LED and photodiode notice a nearby object by reflected infrared (obstacle robots, automatic taps, smart dustbins)
pir: pyroelectric elements feel the moving body heat of a person (motion lights, intruder alarms)
rcwl0516: a Doppler radar that senses motion through thin walls and plastic (motion lights, hidden alarms)
vl53l0x: times invisible laser light pulses to measure millimetre distances (gesture, robot, drone altitude)
sharp_ir: an IR beam and a position-sensitive detector measure distance by triangulation (robots, hand detection)
jsn_sr04t: a sealed ultrasonic transducer measures distance in wet places (water tanks, car bumpers)
tcrt5000: IR LED and phototransistor see black vs white surfaces (line followers, counters, tachometers)
line_array: five IR reflective pairs read where a black line is under a robot (line follower robots)
mmwave: 24 GHz radar that senses even a still, breathing person (smart room presence, energy saving lights)
pir_mini: a small pyroelectric motion sensor (cabinet lights, small alarms)
laser_trip: a laser beam on an LDR; breaking the beam trips an alarm (security tripwire, counters)
ldr: a photoresistor whose resistance falls in light (street lights, night lamps)
bh1750: a photodiode with an ADC that reports light in lux (auto-brightness, plant lighting)
temt6000: a phototransistor tuned to human-eye light (screen brightness, light meters)
tcs3200: photodiodes behind red, green and blue filters measure colour (colour sorting machines)
tcs34725: RGB + clear photodiodes with an IR filter read colour (colour pickers, sorting)
uv_guva: a UV photodiode that measures ultraviolet strength (UV index meters)
uv_ml8511: a UV light sensor that outputs a voltage for UV intensity (sunburn warning)
apds9960: IR LED and four photodiodes read hand swipes, colour and proximity (phone gestures)
photodiode: a photodiode turns light into current, fast (light barriers, IR receivers)
solar: photovoltaic cells turn light into voltage, also usable as a light sensor (solar lamps, chargers)
sound: an electret microphone hears loud sounds (clap switches, noise alarms)
max9814: a mic amplifier that adjusts its own gain (voice recorders, sound-reactive lights)
max4466: an electret mic with an adjustable amplifier (audio level, sound visualisers)
inmp441: a tiny MEMS diaphragm that outputs digital audio (voice assistants, ESP32 audio)
sw420: a spring contact that opens and closes when shaken (theft alarms, machine vibration)
piezo: a piezoelectric disc makes voltage when pressed or knocked (knock detectors, drum pads)
knock_ky031: a spring switch that closes on a tap (secret knock locks)
geophone: a coil on a spring around a magnet senses ground vibration (earthquake and footstep detection)
dht: a humidity pad and a thermistor with a tiny chip (weather stations, room monitors)
dht22: a more accurate DHT humidity + temperature sensor (greenhouses, incubators)
ds18b20: a digital temperature chip sealed in a steel probe (water, aquarium, soil temperature)
lm35: a chip whose output rises 10 mV per degree Celsius (thermometers, fan control)
ntc: a bead whose resistance falls as it heats (overheat alarms, 3D printer beds)
mlx90614: a thermopile reads body or object temperature from infrared without touching (forehead thermometers)
max6675: a K-type thermocouple reads very high temperatures (ovens, kilns, soldering)
bme280: MEMS sensor for temperature, humidity and air pressure (weather stations, altitude)
sht31: a precise polymer humidity + temperature sensor (incubators, server rooms)
amg8833: an 8x8 grid of thermopiles sees heat images (people counting, fever screening)
gas: a heated tin-oxide element that smells LPG, methane and smoke (gas-leak alarms)
mq3: a heated SnO2 element sensitive to alcohol vapour (breathalysers)
mq4: a heated SnO2 element tuned to methane / CNG (natural gas leak alarms)
mq5: a heated SnO2 element tuned to LPG and natural gas (kitchen gas alarms)
mq7: a heated element cycled hot and cool to sense CO (CO alarms near heaters)
mq135: a heated element sensitive to ammonia, benzene, smoke and CO2-like gases (air quality monitors)
mq9: MQ-9 CO and flammable gas sensor
a cycled heated element for CO and flammable gases (multi-gas alarms)
ccs811: a metal-oxide hotplate that estimates eCO2 and VOCs (indoor air monitors)
mhz19: an infrared lamp and detector measure real CO2 by light absorption (classroom CO2 monitors)
sds011: a fan pulls air past a laser; scattered light counts PM2.5 particles (air purifiers, pollution monitors)
gp2y1010: an IR LED and photodiode see light scattered by dust (air purifiers)
bmp280: a MEMS membrane measures air pressure and altitude (drones, weather stations)
soil: a fork probe whose resistance falls in wet soil (automatic plant watering)
soil_cap: measures soil water by capacitance without bare metal that corrodes (smart irrigation)
rain: water drops bridge traces on a plate and lower its resistance (automatic car wipers, rain alarms)
water_level: exposed traces conduct more the deeper they sit in water (tank and flood level)
float: a floating magnet ring closes a reed switch at a water level (water pump control)
flow: water spins a rotor with a magnet; a Hall sensor counts pulses (water meters, dispensers)
tds: two electrodes measure water conductivity = dissolved solids (RO filters, drinking water)
ph: a glass electrode makes a small voltage that depends on acidity (aquariums, hydroponics)
turbidity: light through water: cloudy water blocks more of it (washing machines, water filters)
xkc_y25: senses liquid through a plastic wall by capacitance (water dispensers, coffee machines)
mpu6050: MEMS proof masses sense tilt, shake and rotation (self-balancing robots, drones, phones)
adxl345: a MEMS proof mass senses acceleration, taps and free fall (step counters, crash detection)
mpu9250: gyro, accelerometer and compass in one chip (drones, VR trackers)
hmc5883l: magnetoresistors sense Earth's magnetic field direction (digital compass, robot heading)
sw520d: metal balls roll to open or close a contact when tilted (tilt alarms, toys)
ball_tilt: a rolling ball connects two pins when upright (anti-theft, orientation toys)
encoder: two offset contacts make pulses that tell direction and steps (volume knobs, menus)
optical_encoder: a slotted disc breaks an IR beam to count speed (robot wheel speed, RPM)
hall: switches when a magnet comes near (bike speedometers, BLDC motors, door sensors)
reed: two metal blades in glass touch near a magnet (door sensors, float switches)
touch: senses the capacitance of a finger without pressure (touch lamps, touch buttons)
mpr121: reads 12 capacitive touch pads (touch pianos, fruit keyboards)
fsr: carbon ink whose resistance falls when pressed (pressure pads, smart insoles)
flex: a strip whose resistance rises when bent (robotic gloves, posture)
hx711: strain gauges on a metal bar stretch under weight; HX711 amplifies it (digital scales)
joystick: two potentiometers read X and Y position plus a push switch (RC controllers, games)
keypad: pressing a key connects a row and a column trace (door locks, calculators)
thinfilm: a thin pressure-sensitive film for weight or press detection (seat occupancy, smart beds)
acs712: a Hall sensor measures current flowing through a copper path (power monitoring, battery chargers)
ina219: measures voltage across a tiny shunt resistor to get current and power (battery monitors)
zmpt101b: a small transformer safely samples mains AC voltage (energy meters, inverters)
voltage_div: a resistor divider scales up to 25 V down for an Arduino (battery voltage)
hall_linear: outputs a voltage proportional to magnetic field strength (joysticks, current, position)
door_mc38: a reed switch and a magnet tell if a door is open (home security)
pzem004t: a current transformer and voltage sampling measure power and units (smart electricity meters)
metal_detector: metal near a coil changes its magnetic field and oscillation (metal detectors, security wands)
max30102: MAX30102 heart rate and SpO2 sensor
red and IR LEDs shine into a finger; a photodiode reads blood pulses (smartwatches, oximeters)
pulse: a green LED and light sensor see blood flow with each heartbeat (fitness bands)
ad8232: amplifies the tiny electrical signal of the heart from skin electrodes (ECG monitors)
gsr: measures how well skin conducts, which changes with sweat and stress (stress, lie-detector demos)
emg: electrodes read the electrical activity of muscles (prosthetic hands, gesture control)
fingerprint: a camera images ridges on a glass prism and matches them (attendance, door locks)
rc522: a 13.56 MHz coil powers and reads RFID cards wirelessly (metro cards, attendance)
gps: a ceramic patch antenna receives satellite timing signals to find position (trackers, drones)
pn532: near-field coil reads NFC tags and phones (contactless payment demos, smart locks)
barcode: a camera and LED read printed barcodes and QR codes (shops, inventory)
esp32cam: a tiny camera and WiFi chip capture images (video doorbells, face detection)
hc05: a Bluetooth radio that links a phone's sensors and app to Arduino (phone-controlled robots)
flame: a black IR receiver that sees the infrared of a flame (fire alarms, candle detectors, gas-stove flame checks)
